title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Corridor Noticeboard. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Corridor Noticeboard
options.lineage: university CS-department hallway boards: photocopied flyers on Astrobright paper
options.thesis: Every project, question and job is a flyer you can tear a tab off.
options.viewport: Solar-yellow nav rail, hallway-grey feed, white paper posts; project flyers end in a row of vertical role tabs.
options.risk: Yellow plus black can tip into loud poster styling if the cards grow borders and shadows.

raised.raise: Ink commits: one black and one pencil grey, never a third grey.
One family, Archivo, carries every rank through width and weight.
State is a mark in a fixed cell: open hollow, solved filled.
Right angles only: zero radius on every card, button and input.
Cards share one baseline grid so a feed reads as one board.
Developer grid reflows in whole cells, each with a name plate.

options.label: Conference Lanyard
options.lineage: dev-conference name badges with role ribbons
options.thesis: Every developer is a name badge; roles are ribbons.
options.viewport: Top bar, feed of posts whose author block is a badge with a ribbon for level and language.
options.risk: Familiar: close to what many dev-community sites already ship.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: The feed as a black-and-white data field.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a social feed is prose, not data.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.risk: Novelty wears off on daily use.
options.case: Fuses as costume on a working screen.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size, rank by weight and case.
options.kept: State as marks in fixed cells.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.risk: A map is not a feed.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.risk: Cream and serif is the AI default.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Developers as a ranked mascot roster.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer-community app, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, three columns, white cards on light grey.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
